svg.title: The volume of world exports fell once over 2018–2025, in 2020, and rose in every other year
svg.desc: Column chart: The volume of world exports fell once over 2018–2025, in 2020, and rose in every other year: Volume change: 4.13% in 2018, 1.28% in 2019, −8.51% in 2020, 9.98% in 2021, 7.04% in 2022, 0.76% in 2023, 2.87% in 2024, 4.88% in 2025.
